digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill orchestration and phase scheduling
propositions: Phase 4d subagent dispatch lacks explicit model tier specification, causing silent inheritance of the orchestrator's expensive model tier, negating intended token savings.
The skill omits guidance on which work is safe to delegate to cheaper tiers and when to escalate, leaving implementers unable to make sound capability-cost tradeoffs.
Model names are hardcoded in cross-harness prose, breaking portability to non-Claude systems and rotting as model lineups change across releases.

Test authoring (4b) and held-out validation (4e) must remain on strong tier while implementation (4d) can downgrade to cheaper tiers without breaking the TDD invariant that a separate implementer cannot see the full oracle.
